description: We are Team Quantum Spark from Sylhet, building an AI-powered Fire Fighting & Rescue Robot for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. By integrating satellite data with robotics, we aim to make disaster response safer. Join us if you're passionate about Hardware, Software, or AI!
summary:
IgnisGuard is an advanced automated firefighting and rescue robotic system designed to mitigate wildfire disasters and high-risk urban fire outbreaks. Traditional responses expose human first responders to extreme hazards like toxic gases, structural collapses, and thermal radiation. To eliminate these risks, our project integrates a multi-layered robotic architecture.

Key Features & System Architecture:
- Tracked Mobile Chassis: Heavy-duty metallic tracks enable the robot to safely traverse rubble, debris, and complex rough terrains.
- Sensor Fusion Suite & Satellite Data: Equipped with thermal, flame, and gas sensors, plus audio modules to locate victims. It integrates NASA's MODIS and VIIRS hot spot data to track wildfire distributions accurately.
- Integrated Aerial Drone Unit: Built on a carbon-fiber frame with 2212/920KV motors and an M10 GPS module, featuring an automated docking station for rapid aerial reconnaissance and elevated hazard detection.
- Multi-Terrain Manipulator Arm: Features a specialized mechanical arm and rescue claw to clear physical obstacles and assist in victim extraction.
- Real-Time Telemetry: Live video streams environmental data directly to the control panel, supported by GPS location tracking.

Tools & Hardware: Heavy-duty tracked chassis, carbon-fiber quadcopter drone, M10 GPS module, thermal/gas/flame sensors, mechanical manipulator arm, and wireless video cameras. References include WHO/CTIF fire statistics and NASA satellite data.
